beats.text: The bottleneck? Standard models crave instant gratification, ignoring the thermal decay that naturally turns order into pure, unrecoverable noise.
beats.visual_focus: Entropy increasing in a diffusion pipeline.

beats.text: DDPM reverses this thermodynamic arrow, training a neural network to subtract precise increments of noise at each Markov chain step.
By aligning our loss function with Langevin dynamics, we stop predicting the image and start predicting the score of the noise.
